title: Prove sharp centre encoding bounds and implement native metric services
body:
This PR adds representation theorems and exact local constructions for centre readers. The original sixteen readers need at least **24 complex coordinates** in a Gaussian-dyadic unitary code, and an actual C24 code attains this bound. A different reciprocal reader has a **16-coordinate signed-metric code**. The package also gives an all-size signed scalar family and a rational-unitary C16 comparison with a proved grid-growth limit.

The [proof index](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b051312d7dbd9093b7e8d82e1f009a4764fd61a7/research/centre-metric-encoders/PROOFS.md), [fresh exact replay](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b051312d7dbd9093b7e8d82e1f009a4764fd61a7/research/centre-metric-encoders/evidence/REPLAY.json), and [independent publication review](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b051312d7dbd9093b7e8d82e1f009a4764fd61a7/research/publication-reviews/centre-metric-encoders/REVIEW.md) give the evidence. **There is no improvement to the complete kappa calculation.** The local words do not supply a complete routed caller, terminal decoder, recursive host, finite map price, or full precision bound.

The original reader V has Gram diag(12 I8, 8 I8). Its sharp bound includes arbitrary borrowed inputs, nonlinear exact recovery, and unitary mixing of array and owner coordinates: arrays of length N need at least 24N complex coordinates. The theorem counts capacity and requires the stated dyadic input and output frames. Promised zero inputs, approximate recovery, and general nonunitary codes are outside its scope.

The reciprocal reader L has a different Euclidean Gram, diag(10 I8, 7 I8). It also has a 24-coordinate Euclidean-unitary lower bound, now modulo five or seven. The signed Gram is diag(4 I8, 2 I8). The signed code captures E-P of rank sixteen; E-I has rank thirty-two. Physical P is a paid 32-port code with 160 nonzero entries and a scalar cost of 728 before address-view costs.

The package checks eight complete C24 native words and thirty signed-code or transpose-interface native words. Each acts on 640 arbitrary complex inputs and preserves 416 auxiliary roles. No field, private buffer, CLEAR, or odd division is added. The signed dual conversion includes both arbitrary input banks. The paid 80-primitive selected-pair suffix gives Cbar and repairs the original transpose support defect. **Only C and Cbar encode L in the sixteen selected coordinates. Cbar transpose is a separate native companion interface; its selected sixteen outputs do not decode L.**

| Local service | Forward or raw-dual real scalar cost | Metric-selected dual cost | Q-entry rank mass | I-entry rank mass |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| C24 | 16020 | Not needed | 1792 | 1816 |
| Signed C | 9988 | 11252 | 1792 | 1808 |
| Signed Cbar | 10068 | 11284 | 1792 | 1808 |
| Cbar transpose interface | 10324 | 11156 | 1792 | 1808 |

The standalone C24 code or adjoint costs 8052 real scalar primitives. The [package description](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b051312d7dbd9093b7e8d82e1f009a4764fd61a7/research/centre-metric-encoders/README.md) gives the exact native profiles and frame conditions. Native rank mass is a local invoice, not a multiplication exponent.

For k=2^r and n=k+4, the general signed scalar family has a dyadic metric and inverse. Its price in either direction is 86 for r=0, 96 for r=1, and 10kr+76+4r for r at least two. The proof covers all r; exact checks through k=64 are finite controls. A general native row placement remains open.

The first rational-unitary C16 packs V into sixteen coordinates. Each direction costs 5702 dyadic real primitives plus sixteen real multiplication-by-three scans and sixteen real division-by-three scans. For every positive m, h3(C16^m)=h3((C16*)^m)=m. A matched code/adjoint pair has prefix odd height one, but unmatched repetition has no constant ternary guard. The complete scalar code must stay at a common complex frame, and its recursive endpoint and grid obligations remain open. Its 96 nonzero ordinary diagonals also prevent inheritance of the C24 native realization. This is a useful rational alternative with an exact limit, not a completed native dyadic child.

Reproduce with Python 3.11 or later, the standard library, at least 3 GiB of free disk, and a new output directory. No network access is needed. From the repository root:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/centre-metric-encoders/replay.py --output /tmp/centre-metric-encoders-replay
```

Expected final output:

```text
PASS_CENTRE_METRIC_ENCODERS
```

All seven checks passed in normal and optimized Python. Each fresh receipt matched its frozen receipt byte for byte; all 185 immutable source files and compressed payloads retained their hashes. The independent review repeated all fourteen checks in a cold copy and checked the main matrices with a separate exact engine. Controls reject damaged words, wrong metrics, omitted target-bank scales, wrong dual order or phase, and an insufficient rational division domain. The C24 check tests eight new H8 operators on all 512 spatial columns; the signed checks bind unchanged phase records to their pinned sources. No archived producer rerun, selected-frontier replay, complete recursive supplier check, or Lean formalization was run. The [source record](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b051312d7dbd9093b7e8d82e1f009a4764fd61a7/research/centre-metric-encoders/PROVENANCE.md) documents the two path-only checker changes.

The upstream base is `b58ad9ef4d4e861b0eaa5dba41742bdc072dca51`. At that refresh, the selected record names [PR #4470](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4470) and conditional kappa 60403/20000000 = 0.00302015. The retained local constructions are historical inputs; this PR does not apply them to that selected construction or change its record.

The consumed predecessor pins remain fixed:

- [PR #3133](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3133), at [51eb9c4ee9e4722010d308aa3309e039d3940cc2](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/51eb9c4ee9e4722010d308aa3309e039d3940cc2/research/rank7-coupled-586-588-carrier-fold/README.md), supplies the actual coupled core. Its source credits @dcharb78 for the coupled folds.
- [PR #3148](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3148), at [f2927a4b8afcf0701a6b945e14f30de1d94f5176](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f2927a4b8afcf0701a6b945e14f30de1d94f5176/research/coupled-carrier-cap740/README.md), supplies the base and extra provider words. Its source credits Jeremy Diviney (@jeremydiviney) for the packing exchange, integration, and verification. The retained [notice and contributor record](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b051312d7dbd9093b7e8d82e1f009a4764fd61a7/research/centre-metric-encoders/notices/PR3133-CREDITS.md) preserve the earlier lineage.
- [PR #2588](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2588), at [8cd9dc88e24f062e2ca2fa7f4844a3d3319381fb](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8cd9dc88e24f062e2ca2fa7f4844a3d3319381fb/research/gmx-t74-borrow43-handoff/NOTICE), supplies the retained native-recipe lineage. Its notice separates Cinna Davis (@1337isnot1337)'s dirty-borrowing method, Rohan Arun (@rohanarun)'s package work, and Jeremy Kothe (@jeremykothe2)'s retained methods; no single compiler author is inferred from a submitter account.
- The retained [stopped product-ring and odd-grid source](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f/notes/stopped-product-complex.tex) supplies the common grid method. The [upstream notice](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b051312d7dbd9093b7e8d82e1f009a4764fd61a7/research/centre-metric-encoders/notices/UPSTREAM-NOTICE) credits @icekylinx for that work. The exact C16 division domain and repeated-code height are the new local comparison.

The [notice](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b051312d7dbd9093b7e8d82e1f009a4764fd61a7/research/centre-metric-encoders/NOTICE.md) preserves Apache-2.0 and contributor records. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance was used for the constructions, proofs, agent checks, and publication package.

The [open questions](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b051312d7dbd9093b7e8d82e1f009a4764fd61a7/research/centre-metric-encoders/README.md#open-next-questions) identify the remaining caller and composition work.

The [source-credit addendum](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b051312d7dbd9093b7e8d82e1f009a4764fd61a7/research/publication-reviews/centre-metric-encoders/additional-notices/CREDIT-ADDENDUM.md) retains the referenced [PR #2226](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2226) notices as source context; no implementation from that PR is copied by this package.

The independent publication review was performed by a separate Codex agent; no human peer review is claimed.

The [sign-metric capture annex](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6c6ff8b48ef238a7adebe2391c3c2912ae90f0c4/research/centre-metric-encoders/annexes/sign-metric-capture/README.md) adds a distinct response family with correction rank 16 on the actual 112 ports. The [24-exception construction](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6c6ff8b48ef238a7adebe2391c3c2912ae90f0c4/research/centre-metric-encoders/annexes/sign-metric-capture/frozen/root/SIGN-METRIC-INVOLUTIONS-20261020.md) satisfies `A^2=I` and `A*=DAD` for a diagonal sign matrix D. For diagonal unitary Z commuting with D, `D(ZA)*D=(ZA)^-1` in that order. The entire reader on the 24 selected columns has no Gaussian-dyadic right inverse: eight rows vanish under the ring map to F5 with `i -> 3`. This is an arbitrary-normalization obstruction, not a native impossibility result.

The [unit-capture construction](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6c6ff8b48ef238a7adebe2391c3c2912ae90f0c4/research/centre-metric-encoders/annexes/sign-metric-capture/frozen/root/SIGN-METRIC-UNIT-CAPTURE-20261020.md) uses **32 FULL fields and 16 centre fields**. Its normalized reader L satisfies `L_P=I` and `LA=-L`; its row code has `(C-I)^2=0` and `C^-1=2I-C` over the Gaussian dyadic ring on arbitrary data. The count 32 is sharp only for the stated independent rank-one sign-metric blocks, with every diagonal exception and arbitrary-reader pivot in the FULL fields. Coupled blocks, other frames, code-image division, and general native algorithms are outside this minimum. The actual code fails `C*DC=D`, so the sign-only conversion for ZA does not transfer to ZCA. A separate checked option keeps the 24-exception response, expands its read set to 32 fields, and uses different small centre slots.

The [source manifest](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6c6ff8b48ef238a7adebe2391c3c2912ae90f0c4/research/centre-metric-encoders/annexes/sign-metric-capture/SOURCES.json) retains 26 unchanged files. The [fresh receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6c6ff8b48ef238a7adebe2391c3c2912ae90f0c4/research/centre-metric-encoders/annexes/sign-metric-capture/evidence/REPLAY.json) records ten runs: two producers and three independent checks, each with normal and optimized Python. Both complete response payloads and all receipts match frozen bytes. The checks include exact pair closure, both minor and code inverse orders, the whole-reader obstruction, and rejection of transpose, sign, pair, and coded-metric errors. With Python 3.11+, the standard library, at least 3 GiB free, and a new output directory outside the annex:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/centre-metric-encoders/annexes/sign-metric-capture/replay.py --out /tmp/sign-metric-capture-annex
```

Expected final line:

```text
PASS_SIGN_METRIC_CAPTURE_ANNEX
```

The [fresh independent review](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6c6ff8b48ef238a7adebe2391c3c2912ae90f0c4/research/publication-reviews/centre-metric-encoders/sign-metric-review/REVIEW.md) records a relocated replay and a separate exact reader audit. The accepted parent files and historical manifest stay unchanged; the main suite was not rerun. **There is no native word, complete invoice, or complete kappa improvement.** The old real-1760 tariff and 16-carrier native profile cannot price the changed columns and 32 target paths. Native access, complex scalar lowering, coded forward/backward calls, and full cost and precision remain open. These historical matrix inputs are not an admission to the current selected supplier. The [annex notice](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6c6ff8b48ef238a7adebe2391c3c2912ae90f0c4/research/centre-metric-encoders/annexes/sign-metric-capture/NOTICE.md) credits the root constructions, oblique-native independent checks, controller row data, and cyclic pair data. Apache-2.0; substantial OpenAI Codex assistance was used.
